description: Closed 6-category routing taxonomy and static O(1) intent registry for Reveila TaskCapabilityRouter.

news.search.reason: Intent 'news.search' maps to CLOUD_LIVE_RETRIEVAL (requires fresh real-time news/web search).

web.search.reason: Intent 'web.search' maps to CLOUD_LIVE_RETRIEVAL (requires live web access).

market.watch.reason: Intent 'market.watch' maps to CLOUD_LIVE_RETRIEVAL (requires live market prices).

cloud.research.reason: Intent 'cloud.research' maps to CLOUD_DEEP_REASONING (multi-step synthesis and deep analysis).

agent.workflow.reason: Intent 'agent.workflow' maps to CLOUD_MULTI_STEP_AGENT (multi-turn tool orchestration).

vault.summarize.reason: Intent 'vault.summarize' maps to LOCAL_TEXT_TRANSFORM (operates on local Reference Documents).

local.rewrite.reason: Intent 'local.rewrite' maps to LOCAL_TEXT_TRANSFORM (on-device text formatting/rewriting).

local.extract.reason: Intent 'local.extract' maps to LOCAL_STRUCTURED_EXTRACT (on-device entity/field extraction).

device.action.reason: Intent 'device.action' maps to LOCAL_DEVICE_ACTION (single-step deterministic local action/query).

vault.query.reason: Intent 'vault.query' maps to LOCAL_DEVICE_ACTION (local Reference Documents vector query).

autonomous.task.reason: Evaluated by On-Device SLM Preprocessor into the 6-category routing taxonomy.
